Generate EXACTLY 2 separate residential apartments on this floor.
Do not generate more.

EXACTLY 2 separate residential flats (FLAT 01, FLAT 02).

1 x 2bhk, 1 x 3bhk

UNIT 1 (FLAT 01):
Type: 2BHK
Target area: ~753 sq ft (~70 m²)
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2
Living: 1
Dining: 1
Kitchen: 1
Utility: 1
Balcony: 1

UNIT 2 (FLAT 02):
Type: 3BHK
Target area: ~1,130 sq ft (~105 m²)
Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 3
Living: 1
Dining: 1
Kitchen: 1
Utility: 1
Balcony: 2

TOTAL RESIDENTIAL ROOMS ON THIS FLOOR:
Bedrooms: 5
Bathrooms: 5
Living rooms: 2
Dining areas: 2
Kitchens: 2
Utilities: 2
Balconies: 3

COMMON CORE:
Lifts: EXACTLY 2 distinct elevator shafts (draw a paired dual elevator bank [X][X] side-by-side in the central lobby, clearly showing TWO elevator compartments).
Staircases: EXACTLY 2 separate staircases (one main dog-leg staircase and one separate secondary fire-escape staircase, each with visible treads).
Common lobby: YES
Common corridor: YES

SERVICES:
Ducts: 1
Shafts: 1
Utilities: 2

PARKING:
5 car parking spaces, 4 two-wheeler slots, 1 visitor spaces

AMENITIES:
visitor_parking, society_office

ORIENTATION:
Road side: NORTH
North: 0°

HARD REQUIREMENTS:
1. Generate EXACTLY 2 separate flats.
2. Preserve the exact unit mix.
3. Preserve the exact bedroom counts (total: 5 bedrooms across the entire floor).
4. Preserve the exact requested unit areas.
5. Generate EXACTLY 2 separate elevator shafts side-by-side (paired dual elevator bank [X][X]). Do not draw only 1 lift.
6. Generate EXACTLY 2 separate staircases (two distinct stairwells). Do not draw only 1 staircase.
7. Include the common lobby providing independent access to each flat.
8. Keep apartments clearly separated with independent entrance doors.
9. Do not create additional dwelling units.
10. Do not merge dwelling units.
11. Do not change the building type.

2BHK / 3BHK ORGANIZATION:
Use realistic Indian apartment-planning relationships: entry/foyer → living/dining → kitchen/service zone, with bedrooms grouped as a private zone.
- FLAT 01 (2BHK): Entry/Foyer -> Living + Dining -> Kitchen -> Utility -> Exactly 2 Bedrooms (1 Master Bedroom with attached bath, 1 Bedroom) -> Common Bath -> Balcony.
- FLAT 02 (3BHK): Entry/Foyer -> Living + Dining -> Kitchen -> Utility -> Exactly 3 Bedrooms (1 Master Suite with attached bath, 1 Bedroom with attached bath, 1 Bedroom) -> Common Bath -> Balconies.
- 2BHK vs 3BHK Differentiation: FLAT 02 (3BHK) MUST be visibly larger in floor area and footprint than FLAT 01 (2BHK). FLAT 01 has exactly 2 beds; FLAT 02 has exactly 3 beds. Total beds on floor = exactly 5.
- Common Core Layout: Locate the central core between the two flats containing TWO elevator shafts side-by-side and TWO separate stairwells.

SCHEMATIC:
The supplied deterministic schematic is the primary structural reference. Preserve its unit count, unit grouping, core count, and major circulation structure.

REFERENCE IMAGES:
REFERENCE PRIORITY:
1. USER/MANIFEST REQUIREMENTS
2. DETERMINISTIC SCHEMATIC
3. REFERENCE IMAGE VISUAL STYLE
Use the supplied apartment floor plans for visual style and organizational inspiration. Do not copy their exact geometry or dimensions. The current project requirements always override the references.

DRAWING STYLE:
Professional 2D architectural floor plan. Top-down. Orthographic. Clean technical linework. Strong exterior walls. Clear internal partitions. Clear flat boundaries. Clear common circulation. Clear lifts. Clear staircases. Clear room organization. Minimal furniture. Readable labels. White/light background. Dark architectural linework. NO BORDER FRAME, NO SHEET BORDER, NO TITLE BLOCK, NO LOGO, NO FOOTER BAR, NO BOTTOM LEGEND. Full canvas technical floor plan only.

LANGUAGE:
English only. Latin alphabet only.

FORBIDDEN TEXT:
No Cyrillic. No Russian. No non-Latin script. No gibberish. No pseudo-text. No random room labels. No random apartment numbers. No title block text. No footer banners.

DO NOT GENERATE:
a villa, a single-family house, extra apartments, missing apartments, merged apartments, random rooms, random lifts, random staircases, perspective, 3D rendering, photorealism, artistic sketch, decorative architectural artwork.

OUTPUT:
ONE apartment floor-plan image only.
